latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: Turn text into finished videos with visuals and voiceover in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, TXT, DOCX) for automatic text-to-video creation.
- Simple cloud-based setup with automatic token management and session handling.
- Intuitive prompt-based actions: upload, export, check credits/status, and more.
- Server-side video rendering with instant previews and downloadable exports in common formats.
